structure: Part 3 read, at commit c2078fb (checkout HEAD), in full: app/views/design-release-2.1/consignment-details.html (222 lines), consignment-gross-weight.html (71 lines) and additional-animal-details.html (96 lines); app/routes.js lines 946-1138 (getPackagingFields, isGerminalProductCommodity, formatCommodityGroupHeading, getSelectedCommodityRows, buildSpeciesConsignmentEntry, getConsignmentCommodityGroups, getConsignmentSpeciesEntries), 1166-1427 (parse and validate number of animals, number of packages, germinal packages, net weight, gross weight and storage temperature; getTotalGerminalPackageCount, getGrossWeightValue, showsGerminalGrossWeightField, buildRadioItems), 1582-1710 (getUnweanedOptions, getAdditionalAnimalDetailsConfig, requiresAdditionalAnimalDetailsPage, showsGerminalTemperatureQuestion, hasConsignmentDetails, hasGrossWeightComplete, hasAdditionalAnimalDetailsComplete, no-op redirect guards), 1826-1853 (getPostConsignmentDetailsPath and the gross weight, animal identification and additional details back links), 12221-12292 (the three render functions) and 12927-13202 (GET and POST /consignment-details, /consignment-gross-weight and /additional-animal-details). To resolve values those lines use, it also read app/data/commodities.js, commodity-curated.js, commodities-germinal-products.js, generated/commodities-germinal.json (listed with jq) and certification-purposes.js; routes.js lines 16, 82-83 (certificationPurposeOptions, germinalTemperatureOptions, GERMINAL_QUANTITY_LABEL), 802-828 (species labels, isOtherLiveMammalsCommodityCode), 1711-1824 (getJourneySteps, getNextJourneyPath, the soft-save and section-continue redirects), 2081-2085 (hasAnimalIdentifiersRequired), 2224-2237 (getIdentificationSpeciesLabel), 5167-5179 (hasGerminalProductsOnly), 10352-10393 (allowsBlankJourneyAnswers, applyJourneyValidation, keyValuesBySpecies), the guard stubs at 544, 1162 and 2001, and partials/design-release-2.1/journey-form-actions.html; those are claimed only as far as these three pages use them. Pages covered: /design-release-2.1/consignment-details (title and heading 'Commodity details', caption 'Description of the goods'; a 'Selected commodities' summary with Remove buttons and an 'Add another commodity' link; one section per commodity and one sub-section per species, asking Number of animals plus an optional 'Number of packages (when required)' for live animals, or 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' and an optional 'Number of packages' for germinal products; and a Temperature question with Ambient, Chilled and Frozen when every selected species is a germinal product), /design-release-2.1/consignment-gross-weight (new: shown only for a germinal-only consignment, one 'What is the total gross weight of the consignment?' field in kg) and /design-release-2.1/additional-animal-details (heading 'Additional details', caption 'Commodity details': the certification purpose question unless the consignment is germinal products only, and the unweaned question for cattle or pig). Validation, error messages, saving, journey order, back links, completeness and the save buttons are claimed for each. The earlier extract's per-species 'Total gross weight' claims (p3-030 to p3-033) are dropped, because that field is no longer on the consignment details page.
